## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --all-features` pass
- [ ] Parsing or scientific changes have a focused regression test
- [ ] New fixtures or borrowed code have their source and license recorded in `NOTICE.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and, for format or calibration changes, `README.md` are updated
- [ ] No private acquisition data, patient information or credentials are included
